title: Hardware And Networking Engineer
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled Hardware & Network Engineer to manage, maintain, and support the organizations IT infrastructure. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth operation of computer hardware, network systems, and end-user support while minimizing system downtime and maintaining IT security standards. The ideal candidate should possess strong troubleshooting abilities, hands-on networking knowledge, and the capability to provide timely technical support in a fast-paced work environment.
 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, and servers Diagnose and repair hardware faults and replace defective components Set up and manage LAN/WAN networks, routers, switches, and firewalls Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity issues Configure and maintain Wi-Fi networks and VPN access Provide technical support to end-users for hardware and network-related issues Implement and maintain network security (antivirus, firewall, access control) Perform regular system backups and ensure data recovery processes Maintain inventory of IT assets and hardware Document system configurations, issues, and resolutions Coordinate with vendors for procurement and servicing 
 ELIGIBILTY CRITERIA Bachelors Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related technical discipline 1-3 years of relevant experience in hardware support and network administration Experience in handling enterprise IT infrastructure and end-user support preferred
 REQUIRED SOFT SKILLS Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Good communication and interpersonal abilities Ability to work independently and collaboratively Strong time management and multitasking capabilities Documentation and reporting skills Vendor coordination and stakeholder management abilities 
 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Willingness to travel within Odisha, if required

Key Skills: Hardware Networking,Network Configuration,Device Installation,Hardware Maintenance,VPN Configuration,ip,LAN Setup,CCNA
